messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy requested for service `api-router-eu` -> prod-eu. Symptom: sudden routing 502s after yesterday's route optimizer. Owner: hema. Patch: revert optimizer flag + tighten upstream timeouts. Change window: immediate (10m prep). Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/api-router-hotfix

hema: Short: rolling revert validated in staging under burst load. Need expedited approvals, customer-facing errors on EU.

owen: Ack. Please paste rollback steps and abort criteria.

ops-lead: Rollback (staged test):
```
kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/api-router api-router=registry.redwood/api-router:release-2026-03-10
kubectl rollout status deploy/api-router
```
Abort if 5xx >1% for 5m or p95 latency +200ms delta. Require 2 engineer approvals + ops-lead.

tara: +1 for expedite. I'll enable extra dashboards and take pager for 25m.

vlad: +1. Observability ready.

deploy-bot: Approval flow: react with :thumbsup: to approve. Auto-start in 3m if 2 approvals.

tara: :thumbsup:

vlad: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Approval threshold met. Starting canary: image registry.redwood/api-router:hotfix-revert-2026-03-23 -> 5% traffic to eu-canary. Health checks enabled.

hema: Drafting release note: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/api-router-hotfix-2026-03-23 (RCA, mitigation, rollback).

tara: Canary metrics: 502s down from 3.1% -> 0.2% in 4m. No pod restarts.

vlad: Metrics stable. Recommend bump to 50% after 10m hold.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 50%. Full rollout will proceed after a 20m stable window unless abort.

ops-lead: Confirmed. If errors spike >1% for 5m, run rollback command above.

hema: Thanks team  updating release note and will close thread after post-rollout verification.

tara: Post-rollout: 30m stable, error rate 0.15%, p95 within baseline. Ending pager watch in 10m. :tada:
